pages.text: A reactor requires one $(item)Fission Reactor Controller$(), a casing frame, at least one $(item)Fission Reactor Fuel Cell$(), one $(item)Fission Reactor Interface$(), valid wall blocks and, where needed, $(item)Fission Reactor Cooling Cells$().$(br2)Valid wall blocks belong to $(item)#dustandash:fission_reactor_wall$(); Gray Stained Glass is one example.

Build a square casing frame with equal odd length and width; height may differ. Place Fuel Cells and Cooling Cells inside, then close every wall with valid reactor wall blocks.$(br2)The Controller belongs at the center of the top face. Place the Interface at the center of any side wall.

Fuel and cooling units are inserted through the Interface. Reactor efficiency depends on keeping heat near the fuel's Ideal Heat.$(br2)A Cooling Cell reduces heat growth when placed beside a Fuel Cell. Arrange the interior before loading the reactor.
